concepts.title: Supercells in a Number Grid
concepts.definition: A grid entry earns the supercell tag when its value beats every entry that touches it side-to-side or above-below.
concepts.key_idea: A supercell is a strict local maximum among its immediate horizontal and vertical neighbours.

concepts.title: Count of n-Digit Numbers
concepts.definition: The total count of whole numbers having a specified number of digits is found by subtracting the smallest n-digit number from the largest n-digit number and adding one.
concepts.key_idea: For any positive integer of n digits, there are exactly 9 times 10 to the power of n minus 1 such numbers.

concepts.title: Palindromic Numbers
concepts.definition: Read the digits backwards and you meet the very same number -- such a number is a palindrome (for instance 12321).
concepts.key_idea: A sequence of digits is symmetrical about its center.

concepts.title: Kaprekar Routine Difference
concepts.definition: An iterative routine where the digits of a number are rearranged to form the maximum and minimum possible numbers, and their difference is computed.
concepts.key_idea: Subtracting the smallest digit permutation from the largest yields the next value in the Kaprekar sequence.

concepts.title: Collatz Sequence Step
concepts.definition: An arithmetic transition where an even integer is halved and an odd integer is tripled and incremented by one.
concepts.formula: next_val = n // 2 (if even) or 3 * n + 1 (if odd)
concepts.key_idea: Halve even numbers and apply 3n + 1 to odd numbers until reaching 1.

solution_steps.explain: For an even input n, divide by 2

concepts.title: Winning Strategy in Nim-type Addition Game
